headline: Brown Forman (BF.B) Stock May Be 26% Undervalued Despite Fair Earnings
summary: Brown-Forman stock has fallen sharply over the past three years, yet the current valuation signals are mixed, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate pointing to meaningful upside while market multiples suggest the shares are closer to fair value. The share price has declined 56.3% over the past three years, which puts more focus on whether the current level already reflects the weaker return profile.
